content: {"praised":["Reboot offers fresh take on classic series.","Engaging, fast‑paced procedural with exciting action scenes.","Strong character dynamics and humor keep viewers hooked.","Modern tone appeals to new audience.","Well‑crafted storytelling with clear plotlines."],"criticized":["Acting weak, especially Scott Caan's performance.","Over‑graphic, gaudy visuals detract from story.","Excessive focus on young cast, lacks experienced characters.","Some cases too easy, predictable.","Tone feels uneven, mixing seriousness with silliness."]}
